notes: CONFORMS since kb/Work PB5378 at --std 85. The size of identifier-1 is its number of characters in standard data format (IV.4.3.4) for an elementary item and a group alike: an elementary binary or packed item is its digits, and CommunicationEmitter.SendingText gives a group holding such an item its storage image with each of them replaced by its digits (ItemLength.StandardLayout, CobolStandardData.Image), so the text length range check and the characters sent agree. The golden: a 9(4) BINARY item accepts length 4 and refuses 5; a group of XX and 9(4) BINARY accepts 6 and sends AB0012, 4 sends AB00 and 7 is status 50; a group of a packed item and a table of two COMP items is 7 characters.
